Markets.title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for 10th straight week as markets slide: Is the worst over or more pain ahead?
Markets.summary: Foreign institutional investors dumped Indian stocks for the tenth consecutive week as the Nifty 50 fell 2.4% to close at 22,600. Selling pressure intensified across the broader market, causing the Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 to plunge 5.6% and 7.3%, respectively.

Markets.title: Bitcoin hovers near $80,000 and Ethereum at $2,370 as macro uncertainty and weak institutional flows weigh on crypto markets
Markets.summary: Bitcoin dropped to roughly $80,685 and Ethereum hovered around $2,370 amid weak institutional flows and macro uncertainty. Major altcoins like XRP and Dogecoin also experienced dips as Bitcoin and Ether ETFs saw substantial outflows.

Markets.title: Lenskart, Meesho among top picks as value retail leads India's consumption story: Siddhartha Khemka
Markets.summary: Value-focused retail formats like Lenskart and Meesho are leading India's consumption growth while premium categories face stock and demand challenges. Although rural incomes pose risks to discretionary spending, beauty products continue to significantly influence overall market sales.

Markets.title: Concurrent Losers: 13 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
Markets.summary: During a recent five-day period, 123 stocks within the BSE 500 index declined during every single session. Among those, 13 specific stocks suffered losses ranging between 15% and 25%.

Markets.title: How to win the investing game? Charles Ellis says make fewer mistakes, focus on long-term goals
Markets.summary: Veteran investor Charles Ellis compares successful investing to amateur tennis, where winning comes from making fewer unforced errors rather than spectacular plays. He advises investors to focus on long-term goals and minimize mistakes to outperform the market.

Markets.title: Jio IPO GMP today: Grey market signals over 22% listing gains; check allotment, listing date
Markets.summary: The Jio IPO closed on October 23 with an overwhelming subscription rate of 22.19 times, making it India's largest-ever public offering. Grey market signals currently indicate expected listing gains of over 22% for investors.

Geo-Political.title: France prepares for day of protest a week after nationwide riots
Geo-Political.summary: France is preparing for nationwide protests today, just one week after experiencing severe riots. Authorities have deployed over 70,000 police officers across the country as hundreds of thousands of demonstrators are expected to turn out.

Geo-Political.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's famed Eagle's Nest retreat
Geo-Political.summary: Emergency personnel in Germany deployed about 200 workers to extinguish a fire at Adolf Hitler's former Alpine retreat known as the Eagle's Nest. Authorities subsequently made an arrest in connection with the blaze at the historic site.

Geo-Political.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
Geo-Political.summary: Kaylub Giamanco is hailed as a hero for killing a teenage gunman at an Oregon school. The gunman had fatally shot three children and a teacher before Giamanco intervened.

Geo-Political.title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
Geo-Political.summary: The Trump administration filed a lawsuit to block the certification of an upcoming Alaska election. The lawsuit argues that having two candidates named Dan Sullivan on the ballot would confuse voters.

Geo-Political.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
Geo-Political.summary: A student-led anti-corruption movement has emerged as the biggest electoral challenge to Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić's rule. The two sides are currently locked in a neck-and-neck election.

Geo-Political.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
Geo-Political.summary: A 65-year-old woman in Kenya has died from Ebola, becoming the country's second fatality from the virus. She was a close relative of the first victim, a man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce and industry ministry is working to identify economic sectors that can withstand artificial intelligence-led disruptions. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced this initiative to prepare the country's workforce and industries for technological changes.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to accelerating manufacturing, services, and new orders alongside easing inflation. However, employment growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Taxing the top one percent alone is insufficient to resolve income inequality. How governments choose to spend their revenue is critical to achieving true social justice.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. Refiners increased spot cargo purchases as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz increased.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

India.title: In 1st X Post, Sonia Gandhi Shares Her 'Journey Of Love' With Rajiv Gandhi
India.summary: Sonia Gandhi joined Instagram and X on Thursday to share a message about her forthcoming memoir. She also posted a video on X detailing her journey of love with her late husband, Rajiv Gandhi.

India.title: Mumbai Rapido Driver Arrested For Suspected Jaish Links, Remarks Against PM
India.summary: The Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad arrested a Mumbai Rapido driver named Mohammad Hasan Abu Sarmad Akhtar near the Mahim Metro Station. He was detained based on a tip-off due to suspected links to Jaish-e-Mohammed and making remarks against the Prime Minister.

India.title: UP Board Extends Registration Deadline For 940 Schools Till October 26
India.summary: The UP Board has extended the registration and application deadline for 940 schools until October 26. This extension applies to student lists, Class 9 and 11 registrations, and Class 10 and 12 exam applications for the 2026-27 academic session.

India.title: Congress MP Detained During Jamia Millia Islamia Protests As Students Demand Union Polls
India.summary: A Congress MP was detained during protests at Jamia Millia Islamia as students demanded the reinstatement of student union polls. The university has not held student union elections since 2005, and the body was officially dissolved in 2006.

India.title: Posters Questioning Government Found Inside Delhi Metro Train, Case Filed
India.summary: Posters featuring a QR code to join an online group were found inside a Delhi Metro train. Police and the Special Cell have seized the posters and filed a case regarding the incident.

India.title: Wanted For Murders, Gangsters Himanshu Bhau, Neeraj Faridpuria Arrested In US
India.summary: Wanted Indian gangsters Himanshu Bhau and Neeraj Faridpuria have been arrested in the United States. Bhau, a rival of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi, was facing numerous charges including murder, kidnapping, and extortion in Haryana and Delhi.

General.title: France prepares for day of protest a week after nationwide riots
General.summary: France is deploying over 70,000 police officers as hundreds of thousands of people are expected to participate in nationwide protests. These demonstrations follow a week after severe riots occurred across the country, with some protesters potentially defying official restrictions.

General.title: Met investigates reports of letter detailing claims about Meghan's father
General.summary: Scotland Yard is investigating a letter sent to the Duchess of Sussex containing disturbing allegations about her father. The Metropolitan Police opened the inquiry following reports regarding the contents of the letter.

General.title: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
General.summary: The UK chancellor will announce a £100 million investment to establish an AI Biosecurity Lab during Wednesday's Budget. This funding aims to strengthen the country's national security defences against potential artificial intelligence threats.

General.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
General.summary: Kaylub Giamanco killed a teenage gunman who fatally shot three children and a teacher at an Oregon school. Giamanco expressed anguish because he was unable to save the children who died in the attack.

General.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's famed Eagle's Nest retreat
General.summary: An arrest has been made following a fire at Adolf Hitler's former Eagle's Nest alpine retreat in Germany. Approximately 200 emergency personnel were deployed to battle the blaze at the Nazi dictator's historical residence.

General.title: Celebrity Traitors left on a knife edge after a trip to the field of screams
General.summary: In Friday's episode of Celebrity Traitors, a contestant received a special power after visiting the field of screams. This newly earned ability left the player with a major decision to make regarding the game.
